theorems.name: Submission.p06_9e0f5043ff_fosa_ord_zero_of_monic_pair
theorems.statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L] [Algebra E L] [IsScalarTower K E L] [Algebra.IsIntegral E L] (w : AlgebraicCurve.Place K L) (f : L) (P Q : Polynomial E), f ≠ 0 → P.Monic → Q.Monic → Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap E L) f P = 0 → Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap E L) (f⁻¹) Q = 0 → (∀ i : ℕ, P.coeff i ∈ (w.restrict E).toValuationSubring) → (∀ i : ℕ, Q.coeff i ∈ (w.restrict E).toValuationSubring) → w.ord f = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Map both monic polynomials to L and transfer coefficient membership using mem_restrict_iff. The existing monic-root lemma puts f and its inverse in the valuation subring. Nonzeroness supplies the inverse identities, yielding a unit; ord_coe_unit then gives w.ord f = 0. This matches the frozen parent-supplied proof.
